name: Sudan
value: RSF drones kill 17-19 in Damazin 24 Nov
summary: RSF drone strikes kill 17 to 19 civilians in Damazin and hit Roseires dam power sites on 24 Nov, volunteer groups say
state: Drone strikes on Damazin and Al-Roseires in Blue Nile State on 24 Nov killed 19 civilians, according to the Emergency Lawyers group, or 17 according to the Sudan Doctors Network; both blamed the RSF, and drones also hit power installations at the Roseires dam (Xinhua). Sudan Tribune reported more than 40 RSF drones launched at Blue Nile towns. Sudan's government accused the RSF of executing captured soldiers in Blue Nile, which is unverified (Dabanga). Repeated mass-casualty attacks on civilians keep the Alert.
for_you: Civilians in Blue Nile, Kordofan and Darfur face drone strikes, displacement and hunger; aid access is limited. FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan.
rubric_hit: Alert: massacres reported, with RSF drone strikes killing 17-19 civilians in Damazin on 24 Nov

sources.title: Xinhua — Around 19 civilians killed in drone attacks in SE Sudan: volunteer groups
Sudan Tribune — At least 14 civilians killed as RSF launches over 40 drones at Sudan's Blue Nile towns

why: The world's largest displacement and hunger crisis; regional spillover into Chad, South Sudan and the Red Sea.
drivers: SAF–RSF fighting, sieges, foreign arms supplies, aid access, famine.

rubric.alert: Major sieges or massacres reported, or famine spreading to new areas.
